args: PORTAINER_URL=https://portainer.nicolkrit.ch PORTAINER_TLS_VERIFY=0 PORTAINER_API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_portainer_token) PORTAINER_EXPOSE_ENV_VALUES=1 exec uvx --from 'mcp-portainer~=2.42.0' mcp-portainer
BESZEL_URL=https://beszel.nicolkrit.ch BESZEL_EMAIL="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_beszel_email)" BESZEL_PASSWORD="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_beszel_password)" exec npx -y beszel-mcp

B=$(command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v brave || true); if [ -n "$B" ]; then exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --browser chromium --executable-path "$B" --user-data-dir "$HOME/.claude/playwright-profile" --output-dir "$HOME/.cache/playwright-mcp"; else exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --browser firefox --user-data-dir "$HOME/.claude/playwright-profile" --output-dir "$HOME/.cache/playwright-mcp"; fi

GITEA_HOST=https://gitea.nicolkrit.ch GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_gitea_api_key)" GITEA_TOOLS=get_gitea_mcp_server_version,get_me,get_user_orgs,search_users,search_org_teams,search_repos,search_issues,notification_read,notification_write,label_read,label_write,milestone_read,milestone_write,wiki_read,wiki_write,timetracking_read,timetracking_write,package_read,project_read,project_write,list_issues,issue_read,issue_write,list_pull_requests,pull_request_read,pull_request_write,pull_request_review_write,actions_config_read,actions_run_read,actions_run_write,repo_read,get_repository_tree,get_file_contents,get_dir_contents,create_or_update_file,delete_file,branch_read,branch_write,tag_read,tag_write,commit_read,commit_write,release_read,release_write exec docker run -i --rm -e GITEA_HOST -e GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN -e GITEA_TOOLS docker.gitea.com/gitea-mcp-server:1.13.0

IMMICH_BASE_URL=https://foto.nicolkrit.ch IMMICH_API_KEY="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_immich_api_key)" exec docker run -i --rm -e IMMICH_BASE_URL -e IMMICH_API_KEY ghcr.io/barryw/immichmcp:v3.3.5 --stdio

PAPERLESS_BASE_URL=https://paperlessngx.nicolkrit.ch PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_paperless_api_token)" exec docker run -i --rm -e PAPERLESS_BASE_URL -e PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN ghcr.io/barryw/paperlessmcp:v0.7.0 --stdio

UNIFI_NETWORK_HOST=192.168.1.1 UNIFI_NETWORK_USERNAME="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_unifi_username)" UNIFI_NETWORK_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/claude_mcp_unifi_password UNIFI_NETWORK_SSL_FINGERPRINT=C9:2A:92:55:63:03:57:4A:C6:3F:6C:5D:0E:40:C1:1A:12:13:79:AB:D2:E4:22:93:3D:F2:07:B7:F3:A8:B1:39 UNIFI_TOOL_PERMISSION_MODE=confirm UNIFI_POLICY_NETWORK_DEVICES_CREATE=false UNIFI_POLICY_NETWORK_DEVICES_UPDATE=false UNIFI_POLICY_NETWORK_SWITCH_CREATE=false UNIFI_POLICY_NETWORK_SWITCH_UPDATE=false UNIFI_POLICY_NETWORK_SWITCH_DELETE=false exec uvx unifi-network-mcp==0.45.0

OPENCLOUD_URL=https://opencloud.nicolkrit.ch OPENCLOUD_USER=krit OPENCLOUD_APP_TOKEN="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_opencloud_app_token)" exec docker run -i --rm -e OPENCLOUD_URL -e OPENCLOUD_USER -e OPENCLOUD_APP_TOKEN opencloudeu/opencloud-mcp@sha256:4036092d3dafd23478bb1e7c41d2e7f7dba9f524b4080310150caf951249b49d --toolsets spaces,files,search,versions,sharing,people,tags,activity,apps
